methods.label: Square the similarity ratio
methods.explanation: Homothetic figures are similar figures, and the homothety ratio is the similarity ratio. The area ratio is the square of the similarity ratio: \(1:4\).
methods.levelReason: This is a direct application of the Grade 9 square law for areas of similar figures.
